paragraphs: At the start of a shift, sharpen knives and check temperatures. On the line, cut by anatomical section, debone, trim fat, and classify each cut correctly. During gaps, wipe down the station and check thermometers. At handoff, weigh output, calculate waste, and separate nonconforming products for rework.

In short, they divide whole carcasses into cuts. Work includes cutting and deboning, trimming and grading, maintaining hygiene and temperature, controlling yield and waste, sharpening knives and maintaining equipment, and recording quantities for handoff.
